purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCSBTUSENTEI) retrieves and assembles inpatient disease/condition (病棟選定) charge determination information for a given patient and service month. It fetches system master data (table 5001 — ward/room charge settings), patient hospitalization history records, and calculates applicable daily charge amounts, taking into account elderly patient status via a separate age-check subprogram.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims — ORCA JMA receipt software)

verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are clearly Japanese (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS in the original). The program is part of the well-known open-source ORCA medical receipt system maintained by the Japan Medical Association. Source is truncated at 16000 chars (~65% of the file) but enough structure is visible to classify with high confidence. The MCP (middleware call protocol) pattern is characteristic of ORCA's PostgreSQL access layer via GnuCOBOL.
